home.title: One country. Connections. Your voice.
home.lead: Read open publications, find official pages and join conversations with a social identity you control.
home.contextTitle: A clear origin, a deliberate share
home.contextBody: Conversations in a closed network stay there. A contribution appears here when its author chooses public distribution on {{brand}}.

snapshot.title: Network measures
snapshot.pending: Public measurements are not available yet.
snapshot.bounded: Bounded measurement: some publications, pages or topics may be omitted.

feed.title: The origin feed
feed.lead: Publications you can read without an account. Open your member space to publish or participate.
feed.emptyTitle: No public publication in this view
feed.emptyBody: Member content stays within its context. Explore another province or join the network.
feed.filteredWindow: This window has no visible publication. A next page remains available.

discover.title: Discover the network
discover.lead: Explore a province or topic and read contributions their authors chose to make public.

provinces.title: The nine provinces
provinces.lead: A publication’s province is chosen by its author. It does not indicate residence or location.

unavailable.title: Reading is temporarily unavailable

handoff.body: Your session must be confirmed before reading the content.

session.unavailable: Your session cannot be confirmed. Try again to resume sign-in.
session.handoffRefused: The sign-in transfer could not be confirmed. Start a new sign-in.

transparency.title: Moderation transparency
transparency.lead: Aggregated totals by period, without identities, individual reasons or case content.
transparency.threshold: A period is published only when it has at least {{count}} cases and {{count}} distinct authors.
transparency.empty: No aggregated period is available yet.

legal.draft: Working version. Legal information and service terms require validation before public release.
legal.journal: Official Journal: Law No. 025/2023 of 12 July 2023

about.title: One network, several contexts
about.lead: {{brand}} connects the public life of the network with contributions voluntarily shared by its child networks.

purpose.title: People keep their social identity
purpose.body: Each person chooses a handle and a profile. An additional network adds a participation context; it does not create a second person.

contexts.title: Making content public remains a choice
contexts.body: Content restricted to a closed network is not shown in this public view. Distribution on {{brand}} requires an explicit choice and a public audience; withdrawal of that distribution also applies here.

trust.title: Trust indicators are calculated
trust.body: Official describes the trust attributed to an institutional page. Verified and Public agent rely on active identity evidence. Community describes participation without those additional proofs. These indicators do not guarantee a publication’s truthfulness.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.lead: Information identifying the publisher and the service terms is being validated.

publisher.title: Publisher and responsibilities
publisher.body: NTSAGUI Digital leads this project. Its full legal name, contact details and publication responsibility must be completed and validated before publication. The technical provider and processing locations remain undecided.

law.title: Data protection
law.body: The Gabonese framework includes Law No. 001/2011, amended by Law No. 025/2023 of 12 July 2023. APDPVP procedures and the applicability of the GDPR, particularly Article 3, must be assessed with legal counsel according to the processing and people concerned.

publication.title: Validation status
publication.body: These texts are not a declaration of compliance, an APDPVP approval or evidence of data location. Release remains subject to validation of the texts and operating conditions.

privacy.title: Privacy and your choices
privacy.lead: Understand what is public and find the controls for your profile, consents and data.

profile.title: Your publications and profile
profile.body: Reading without an account shows only admitted public projections: open publications, reduced profiles and Official pages. Private mode and profile withdrawal apply across the engine. Withdrawing a profile does not automatically delete its publications; publication withdrawal and data rights are separate controls.

cookies.title: Sign-in and optional measurement
cookies.body: Cookies specific to {{brand}} correlate the browser session with server rendering. They support sign-in and its closure. Optional usage measurement requires specific consent; reading public content does not grant it.

rights.title: Your data controls
rights.body: My data provides preferences, consents, notifications, export and erasure requests, and appeals. It remains available if network participation is suspended. Controller contact details, legal bases, retention periods and response procedures must be completed during legal validation.
